description: This file defines the Vault class for managing encrypted notes, including vault creation, locking/unlocking notes, changing passwords, and content encryption/decryption within the Notesnook project.

classes.name: Vault
classes.description: Class for managing encrypted vault operations such as create, lock, unlock, change password, and note encryption/decryption.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new vault with the specified password.

methods.name: lock
methods.description: Locks the vault, clearing the password from memory.

methods.name: unlock
methods.description: Unlocks the vault with the provided password.

methods.name: changePassword
methods.description: Changes the vault password, re-encrypting contained notes.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears all notes from the vault.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes the vault and optionally all locked notes.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Locks (adds) a note to the vault.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes (unlocks) a note from the vault.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves a note in the vault.

methods.name: getVaultPassword
methods.description: Retrieves the current vault password, throws if vault is not available or locked.
